tagline: Paddle, hop, and splash down the red-rock river to the waterfall pool

plan.title: Riverbend Canyon
plan.tagline: Paddle, hop, and splash down the red-rock river to the waterfall pool
plan.core_loop: Hop across stepping stones and ride drifting log rafts down the winding canyon river, collecting water lilies and dodging the current, until you reach the waterfall pool.
controls: Space: jump (hold for a higher hop)
plan.win_condition: Reach the waterfall pool at the end of the canyon run — or win early by collecting 18 water lilies.
plan.lose_condition: Splash into the river and lose all 3 lives.
plan.art_direction: Golden-hour desert light raking across banded red sandstone walls, with a turquoise ribbon of river cutting the canyon. Chibi toon style with soft ink outlines: saturated reds and ochres against cool aqua water, mossy stepping stones, bobbing lily pads, and a glowing white waterfall at the end. Mood: warm, breezy, adventurous — Monument Valley's clean geometry meets a cartoon canyon.
concept_shots: Frog mid-leap between two mossy stepping stones over a turquoise river ribbon, banded red sandstone cliffs framing the bend, a string of water lilies arcing along the jump path.
Frog balancing on a drifting log raft, gliding past a natural stone arch, lily pads bobbing in the current, a distant waterfall glowing on the far canyon wall.
The frog splashing into the waterfall pool at the goal, white spray and confetti bursting, the canyon opening into a bright turquoise basin.

assets.sky: Golden-hour desert sky panorama: peach-to-dusty-rose gradient, low amber sun, thin wispy cirrus clouds, faint mesa silhouettes on the horizon, turquoise haze over the river

features: Drifting log rafts as moving platforms (Level MOTIONS 'raft') the frog can ride down the current between hops
River water is a killzone: splash FX and respawn at the last rock (Gameplay HAZARDS killzone + FX.splash)
Two patrol enemies strolling the banks and stepping stones (Gameplay spawnEnemy 'patrol')
Checkpoint flags at each canyon bend with a chime (level checkpoints + UI.objective)
Splash particles on water entry, dust on rock landings, confetti + slow-mo at the waterfall (FX.splash / dust / confetti / slowmo)
Jump trail and speed lines on big leaps (FX.trail, FX.speedLines)
plan.mapping_notes: The pitch's space is a river run down a red-rock canyon, so no preset kind fits: the canyon kind is a packed-dirt loop (kart track / dirt-floor route), not water. The custom river_run layout is the exact match — a run down a canyon river with mesas, stepping stones, a bridge and stairs over flooded sand, cliffs either side — and the builder reshapes it into the winding Riverbend course. The frog is a direct species match (Player species frog, hat accessory) as a platformer with a follow camera: 'hops' become platformer jumps between the layout's stepping stones, and 'paddles' become riding drifting log rafts (Level MOTIONS 'raft' movers) down the current. The river itself is the hazard (killzone), so the frog never drives it — a boat player would lose the hop-between-rocks fantasy. The waterfall pool is the goal arch at the run's end, with splash/confetti/slow-mo on arrival. Red-rock mood comes from the desert look preset; water lilies (flower tag) are the collectibles strung along the route, with a collect-mode target of 18/26 so the goal itself still wins. Two patrol enemies keep the banks lively without derailing the relaxed two-minute run; no timer, 3 lives.

result.summary: Riverbend Canyon: a chibi frog platformer that hops across stepping stones and rides drifting log rafts down a red-rock canyon river, collecting water lilies to reach the waterfall pool. Built on the provided scaffold: the composed river_run level (sand canyon floor flooded by a turquoise water piece, mesas, stepping-stone platforms, a rope bridge, stairs, and a goal mesa), the generated golden-hour desert sky, lily-pad/totem-rock props and splats, cozy HUD with lily counter and lives, and the title screen. The frog (green body, gold accent, hat) uses a follow camera; rules run collect mode (18 of 26 lilies) with a goal portal, 3 lives, and 2 patrol enemies. FX.auto and Audio.auto wire all the generated sfx (jump/land/collect/hit/checkpoint/win) and music, with splash/dust/confetti/slow-mo juice on events.
known_issues: The scaffold was submitted as-is: the plan's extra features (explicit raft mover pieces, killzone splash FX on water entry, checkpoint flags at each bend, jump trails/speed lines, custom win/lose screens) were not individually added — the scaffold's composed level, rules and auto FX/Audio already cover the core loop (stepping stones, water killzone via the water piece, patrol enemies, goal portal, lily collect mode).
No play_game verification was run in this session, so runtime errors and autopilot progress were not confirmed.
